what: Add to round.sh beside query_hit: `cargo bench -p hir-ty --bench impls` (crates/hir-ty/benches/impls.rs, harness=false). It prints one line: cold time of the walk over every loaded crate vs crates_that_name, the ratio, and a gain or NO GAIN: remove crates_that_name; it asserts both find the same impls. On NO GAIN, revert crates_that_name and its three callers in crates/hir-ty/src/method_resolution.rs, method_resolution/naming_tests.rs, the CRATES_THAT_NAME kind in hir-ty/src/db.rs, the bench and its [[bench]] stanza (details in /tmp/blaze-lanes/v2-filters.md).
